nie.mcp: optional aphrody-mcp nie.* (disabled by default until NIE source crates join this monorepo; process boundary runs nie-mcp as a child; the IECODE agent plugin is stored in ~/plugins/iecode and restricted to IECODE)
nie.desktop: none: IEVR features are web-only (nie-site + apps/nie-web). The Inacord Tauri app was removed on 2026-09-26; its generic pet/pixel pipeline lives in crates/aphrody-identity; game features stay behind the opt-in aphrody-mcp nie.* capability

data.localIndex: sqlite (nie-index RE knowledge base and atlas, var/)
data.optionalPostgres: nie-pg schema nie (cfg.bin import, manual run)
data.optionalRedis: nie-index atlas mirror, opt-in via NIE_ATLAS_REDIS / --redis; no Redis service contract (OPEN-RESERVATIONS #3)
data.schedules: none (no nie timer or cron is declared or deployed)

aphrody.desktop: the COSMIC session and the iced/libcosmic clients of the unified Bun OS image; the Tauri desktop apps/aphrody-app was retired on 2026-10-31
aphrody.gameFeatures: opt-in aphrody-mcp nie.* only; disabled in the root build until NIE is integrated; Bun OS clients never import IECODE sources through sibling paths
